transcript_for_reference: Thanks for calling the shop, this is Alex. — Hi, my check engine light came on this morning and the car is idling rough. — I can get you in for a diagnostic. Are you free tomorrow at 8? — Tomorrow at 8 works. — You're booked; bring the key fob and we'll call you by noon.

observations.strengths: Named the shop, asked what the car was doing, offered a specific time and booked it.
